assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.description: Explains the causes of risk and helps check scenarios.
assistant.welcome: Hello! I answer from the saved forecast: gap risk, the biggest payments, what to check and how to reduce risk. Numbers come from the calculation, nothing is made up. Answers are produced by rules — no LLM provider is connected and no external services are called.
assistant.noForecastText: The assistant answers from the saved forecast. Upload a statement and build a forecast first.
assistant.thinking: The assistant is analysing the data…
assistant.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question about the forecast…

suggestions.cause: Why is a cash gap possible?
suggestions.delay: What if a big client pays 2 weeks late?
suggestions.biggest: Which payments are the largest in the next 2 weeks?
suggestions.reduce: How can I reduce the risk?

replies.help: I answer from the saved forecast. Try asking: “Why is a cash gap possible?”, “What if a client pays 3 weeks late?”, “Which payments are the largest?”, “What should I check first?”, “How can I reduce the risk?”.
replies.gapNone: According to the saved forecast no cash gap is expected: probability {{probPercent}}, expected balance at the end of the period — {{endKop}}.
replies.gapHead: The probability of a cash gap over {{horizon}} days is {{probPercent}} ({{levelKey}}).
replies.gapWhen: Likely date — {{whenDate}}; typical shortfall {{typicalKop}}, in a bad case (90th percentile) {{p90Kop}}.
replies.biggestNone: There are no planned payments in the forecast for the 14 days after {{asOfDate}}.
replies.checkNextOut: • Next payment: {{dateDate}} — {{title}}, {{amountKop}}. Make sure there is enough money on that date.
replies.checkNextIn: • Next expected receipt: {{dateDate}} — {{title}}, {{amountKop}}. Confirm the payment date with the counterparty.
replies.checkRisk: • Gap risk {{probPercent}}: consider postponing payments or speeding up receipts.
replies.checkNone: The saved forecast gives no serious reasons for a check.
replies.reduceNone: The gap risk in the saved forecast is low ({{probPercent}}). For a safety margin, see how the picture changes in the what-if scenarios.
replies.reduceHead: Risk {{probPercent}}. Options worth testing in scenarios:
replies.reduceHeadDate: Risk {{probPercent}}, likely date {{whenDate}}. Options worth testing in scenarios:
replies.reduceMove:
• Postpone or split large payments before that date:
{{itemsLines}}
replies.reduceCover: • Prepare a source to cover a shortfall of up to {{p90Kop}} (bad case).
replies.taxRule: A recurring tax payment was found ({{name}}, about {{amountKop}}), but it does not fall into the coming period.
replies.taxNone: There are no tax payments in the saved forecast. You can add them in “Payments & obligations”.
replies.expensesNone: No recurring expenses found in the history.
replies.scenarioDelay: Scenario: a big client pays {{days}} days late.
